title: Amazon partners with Uber to make Uber Eats the "official" US restaurant delivery partner for Amazon Prime subscribers, after previously partnering with Grubhub (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary: Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge: Amazon partners with Uber to make Uber Eats the “official” US restaurant delivery partner for Amazon Prime subscribers, after previously partnering with Grubhub — Prime members can now order takeout straight from the Amazon app or website with waived delivery fees on orders over $25.
